name: vtable
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) 0x57441C for the abstract base, 0x574458 for StaticSound, 0x57449C for StreamSound. 15 slots.

name: looping
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) 1 = pass DSBPLAY_LOOPING to IDirectSoundBuffer::Play. Also switches Sound_SetBufferPosition to fractional-wrap mode and makes StreamSound_ReadOrPadSilence rewind instead of padding silence.

name: wave
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) The source .WAV reader. Deleted through its own vtable slot 0 when waveIsExternal == 0.

name: waveIsExternal
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) 1 = the WaveFile belongs to somebody else, do not delete it. Set to 1 by both ctors and by CreateFromWave; only CreateFromFile clears it.

name: buffer
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) The secondary buffer. Released (vtbl+8) by every teardown path; NULL means the sound is not created.

name: bufferBytes
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) DSBUFFERDESC.dwBufferBytes. For StaticSound it is the whole data chunk; for StreamSound it is notifySize * nNotifications and is the modulus for writeOffset.

name: volumeCb
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) Current attenuation in centibels, -6000..0. Initialised to -3000 by both derived ctors.

name: panCb
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) Current pan in centibels, -10000..+10000 (DSBPAN_LEFT..DSBPAN_RIGHT).

name: baseFrequency
meaning: (StaticSound shares Sound's layout exactly; only the vtable differs, 0x574458.) Sample rate. Filled by IDirectSoundBuffer::GetFrequency right after creation (StaticSound only), and overwritten by Sound_SetBufferFrequency with the requested rate.
